# S334 — Landing: the slice's own JSON deleted by the branch (moved to done/) but edited on main

*Proposed.* Drafted 2026-11-11. When the landing's merge-in stops because the branch moved `.slicer/slices/ID.json` to `.slicer/slices/done/ID.json` (`slicer done`) while main edited the old path, ork pauses with the generic reason, and its retry never resolves the deleted path. This slice handles that case. S289 (landed 2026-11-11) covers only a slice JSON changed on both sides (adj 294, `landing.tracking-conflict-scope` = slice-json-only). The owner asked for this follow-up on 2026-11-11 for v1.2.

**Findings:** 2026-11-11 S328 landing: merge-in stopped on '.slicer/slices/S328.json' DU (branch moved it to done/ via slicer done; main had spec-answer edits). Fixed by hand: merge main's change into done/S328.json, git rm the old path, ork retry. ork's retry does not stage a deleted path. S217 (2026-11-09) hit the same case. · **Size:** S `[needs-owner]` · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

*Proposed.* Evidence:

- S328, run `ork-20261111-141133-aa62`, 2026-11-11: the pause read "merging main into S328 stopped on conflicts in .slicer/slices/S328.json". `git ls-files -u` showed stages 1 and 3 only (DU: deleted by us). The branch had run `slicer done`, which moves the file to `done/`. Main had spec-answer edits to the old path, written after the worktree was created. The orchestrator three-way merged main's change into `done/S328.json` with `git merge-file` (here main's edit was older than the branch's rewrite, so the branch copy was kept), ran `git rm` on the old path, and ran `ork retry`.
- The first `ork retry` paused again. `settleMerge` (`internal/engine/landmerge.go:82`) stages only paths that exist and have no markers (`os.Lstat` fails for the deleted path, so it is skipped). A deleted-by-us path therefore stays unmerged until someone runs `git rm`.
- S217 (2026-11-09) hit the same case, recorded in S289's notes ("'.slicer/slices/S217.json deleted by us'").
- The source of most of these edits on main is spec answers recorded after the worktree exists. S330 (landed 2026-11-11) commits the item's tracking edits at launch, but answers written later still land on main only.

Open owner questions (the owner answers before the relay starts):
- Q1 what ork does. (a) resolve it itself: when the only unmerged path is the item's own `.slicer/slices/ID.json` in DU state and `.slicer/slices/done/ID.json` exists on the branch, three-way merge main's change (stage 1 to stage 3) into the `done/` copy. If that merge is clean, `git rm` the old path, re-render and go on. If it conflicts, pause with the S289 merge-both wording naming the `done/` file (recommended). (b) pause only, with one line naming the move and the two commands (`git merge-file`, `git rm`). (c) always keep the branch's `done/` copy and `git rm` the old path, dropping main's edit.
- Q2 retry staging. (a) on `ork retry`, a DU or UD path whose working-tree file is absent is staged as deleted (`git rm --cached`) when the item's `done/` copy exists, so the owner's hand fix needs no `git rm` (recommended). (b) leave the retry as it is.
